## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated PHPUnit coverage for changed behavior.

## Compatibility

List any effect on supported PHP, Laravel, REST, or MCP contracts. Use `None` when there is no compatibility impact.
